VILA Lab at MBZUAI reports in a new arXiv preprint that Flash-dLLM ran 5.1× faster than Elastic-Cache on GSM8K and 11× faster on HumanEval with LLaDA-1.5 on one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU.
Flash-dLLM’s authors use the diffusion model for training-free draft-and-verify decoding, but test it only on structured math and code, leaving open-ended writing and dialogue untested.
